string-array.name: CAR_PRIVACY_CENTER_TRIP_AND_SENSOR_DATA_LEARN_MORE_LIST_LIST
string-array.item: Updates to the map based on trip & sensor data are not associated with your Google Account or vehicle

Trip & sensor data is also not associated with your Google Account, but with a securely generated identifier that resets on a regular basis. That means Google cannot look up this data based on your Google Account
Other data collected as you explore the world, such as when you use the Google Assistant, may be associated with your Google Account. You can control your history by visiting myactivity.google.com
To change location permission, go to Settings > Apps and notifications > App permissions > Location > Maps
Google only collects the trip & sensor data needed to provide the best Maps experience for everyone—after processing, it’s deleted
